scripts.android:apk: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(brew --prefix openjdk@21)/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew assembleDebug && mkdir -p ../../releases/debug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../releases/debug/Nabra-debug.apk
scripts.android:release: VITE_RELEASE=true npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(brew --prefix openjdk@21)/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../../releases/$npm_package_version && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../releases/$npm_package_version/Nabra-$npm_package_version.apk
scripts.android:aab: VITE_RELEASE=true npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(brew --prefix openjdk@21)/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew bundleRelease && mkdir -p ../../releases/$npm_package_version && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../../releases/$npm_package_version/Nabra-$npm_package_version.aab
scripts.android:dist: npm run android:release && npm run android:aab
